text: Signalised crossroads, 100 second cycle, one approach at a time. Peak 15-minute counts: from the north 25 left, 150 straight, 25 right; from the south 20 left, 120 straight, 20 right; from the east 100 vehicles, a third of them turning right and the rest going straight; from the west 90 vehicles. Single lane on each arm, 50 km/h. There is a pedestrian crossing on the west arm.
